title: [main] Registering a Warehouse Movement with "Breakbulk Filter" enabled registers only the visible lines; hidden breakbulk lines remain unregistered
summary: Warehouse movement registration now includes all breakbulk lines even when the breakbulk filter is enabled, ensuring complete movement registration instead of leaving intermediate lines unregistered.
key_points: Selects all movement lines before registration to bypass subpage filters
Fixes issue where intermediate breakbulk lines remained unregistered
Adds regression test verifying complete line registration and movement deletion
quote: Warehouse movements remain partially registered when Breakbulk Filter is enabled
